title: Completed direct sum embeds universally injectively into the product
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $I\subseteq R$ be an ideal, and assume $R$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. For a set $A$, let $F=\bigoplus_{a\in A}R$ be the module of finitely supported families and let $\widehat F=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}F/I^nF$ be its $I$-adic completion, with componentwise operations. The canonical $R$-linear coordinate map $\iota:\widehat F\to\prod_{a\in A}R$ sends a compatible family of residue classes to its coordinatewise $I$-adic limits. For every $R$-module $Q$, the map $Q\otimes_R\iota:Q\otimes_R\widehat F\to Q\otimes_R\prod_{a\in A}R$ is injective.
